note: The savings desk: where the bank is willing to place a customer's stablecoins. Every venue is one audited, battle-tested contract on the bank rail, its address read back on chain (symbol()/asset()/baseToken()) before it was written down. An index fund is a weighted basket of venues in ONE asset on ONE chain, so placing it is a handful of wallet signatures. APY hints are frozen fallbacks from 2026-08-31; live numbers come from DefiLlama at request time and every response says which it is showing.
